author: Helder_C

title: Awesome and recommended
text:
The idea of having a tour in a scooter is awesome, so entertaining and you have time to visit more places. Our “professor” tour guide had a lot of information, knowledge and helpful facts about Seville, actually I’d considered to invest in an audio system between the tour guide and the people so that the knowledge of the tour guide can be shared and heard all the time while we ride around.  
Super recommended!!
author: Escape301102

title: A highlight of our city break
text: Our guide was fantastic, made the tour so interesting and just at the right level of detail. Learnt so much and saw so many great sights. Absolute must and what a great way to learn about Seville and travel both sides of the river.
author: 480vaughanj

title: Great fun
text: An excellent tour.  Knowledgeable, friendly guide.  The scooters were really fun and safe - we were on the cycle paths.  Highly recommended
author: Katherine C

title: Scooter tour really worth it
text: Great tour, The guide, Francisco, was very knowledgeable and he showed us a lot of places that we would not know about, even some personal recommendations. Would definitely come back. Thank you for the great time
author: maximelH9475SH

title: Great Scooter tour of Seville
text:
This tour was fun, full of historic information and enough time to see the areas around Seville. Our tour guide was great, friendly and funny. 
Only prob was trip advisor had the wrong meet point. But there was a telephone number for the tour guide and we sorted to. Note to self make sure you contact them the day before to confirm location.
author: Jo B

title: Excellent, efficient and detailed tour of Seville.
text: We had a very informative guide, Luis, who was very passionate about the history and architecture of Seville and communicated information about the tour very well. The points of interest were fascinating as much as they were gorgeous. The scooter options worked very well and we felt confident on them even in crowded areas.
author: srbbass

title: The guide was great, very...
text:
The guide was great, very passionate about Seville.
Unfortunately it rained during the 2nd hour. Do not do this tour if rain is forecast as there is no escape! We still saw lots.
author: Catherine_B

title: Excellent
text: Our family took Francisco’s scooter tour of Seville and highly recommend. Excellent information, timing, service, knowledge, and overall experience.

title: Amazing
text: The guides knowledge was excellent thank you francisco for a great 2 hours one of the best things I have ever done
